How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    Why I Purchased This Product

    I’ve bought a dozen of the Next Level Apparel Men’s N6210 shirts because I love soft, lightweight T-shirts that are comfortable for everyday wear. These shirts seemed like a great option, and for the most part, they’ve lived up to my expectations.

    Key Features & My Experience

    The fabric is incredibly soft and lightweight, but not that overly thin or see-through material that some shirts use. They’re stretchy as well, which makes them very comfortable to wear all day.

    Overall, the fit is great and true to size for most colors I purchased. That said, I’ve found some inconsistencies—while some XXL sizes fit perfectly, others (like the black/Heather colors) were noticeably smaller and too tight to wear.

    I like the color options available, but I wish there were even more styles or color choices.

    The material isn’t the longest-lasting, but at this price point, they’re affordable enough to replace when needed.

    Unfortunately, I did have issues with a portion of my order. About three shirts out of the dozen came in the wrong size or color. While it wasn’t worth the hassle of returning them, it would’ve been nice to receive the correct items I ordered.

    Pros and Cons

    Pros:

    Super soft, lightweight, and stretchy material that’s very comfortable.

    Affordable pricing makes them easy to replace when they wear out.

    Great for casual wear and layering.

    Comes in a nice selection of colors.

    Cons:

    Sizing inconsistencies between colors (e.g., some XXL shirts run smaller).

    Incorrect sizes/colors were sent for a few shirts in my order.

    The material isn’t built for long-term durability.

    Who This Product Is Best For

    These shirts are ideal for anyone looking for affordable, comfortable T-shirts for casual wear. If you prefer soft and lightweight material that’s stretchy and modern, these are a great option. However, if you’re looking for a shirt that will last for years or need absolute consistency in sizing, you may want to keep that in mind before ordering.

    Final Thoughts and Rating

    Overall, the Next Level Apparel Men’s N6210 shirts are a great value for the price. They’re soft, stretchy, and lightweight without feeling cheap or see-through. While the sizing inconsistencies and wrong items in my order were a little frustrating, I enjoyed these shirts enough to keep buying them. I’ll likely continue to purchase more in the future!

  • DUG
    4 out of 5 stars
    5'8" 165lbs. Medium is great with a little length removed.
    Reviewed in the United States on August 1, 2016
    Size: SmallColor: Indigo
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I bought the medium. I'm 5'8" 165lbs. Decently muscled across the chest, back, shoulders, and arms. The problem I run into with shirt buying is that mediums always fit great from the chest up yet they are too long and too baggy from the chest down. Smalls usually fit great from the chest down but they are too freaking tight from the chest up. I bought one of each small and medium just to test the waters. One bad thing to note is that the shipping is painfully slow. It took 14 days from when I ordered until I received the shirts, but that has nothing to do with the shirts. Just be aware.

    So on to the fit. The small was a no go. Too tight. Actually gave it to my wife to sleep in. The shirts are super soft. I love the material. They do shrink so wash and dry them a couple of time before judging the fit. After doing so the medium fit fantastic in every way other than length. Too long. If I were a couple of inches taller they would fit perfect. If you lay the shirt out flat it measures 28" from the shoulder seam near the neck to the bottom of the shirt (after shrinking). I can not stand long shirts. All the extra length bunches up around the waist as you move. I freaking hate it. So I take them and have them hemmed up to my liking. These are super comfortable, quality shirts for less than 6 bucks each. They are my favorite shirts. To the point that I am sad if I don't have one clean to wear.
